messages:
ryan_se: Quick sync — ACME wants a POC that mixes Hosted API keys for dev and a small Dedicated pool for scale testing. Can we provision both under one workspace, and how do we set invites/roles for their engineers so they have least privilege?

sara_ae: Yes we can mix. Workspace supports multiple models/modes. Main asks: (1) RBAC roles for guest engineers (no billing), (2) ephemeral keys for contractors, (3) pricing for a small Dedicated pool + hourly overage.

maya_infra: For Dedicated we need a pool reservation (min 4 GPUs for their test window) — pricing is monthly commit + overage. For POC we can do a short-term promo rate if legal approves. For RBAC: create workspace role "poc_engineer" with read/write to routes but no billing permission. I can script invites.

ryan_se: @maya_infra can you share the invite payload we use? I want to confirm fields for SSO vs email invites.

maya_infra: Sure — sample invite payload we use:```json
{
  "email": "eng+acme@example.com",
  "role": "poc_engineer",
  "expires_at": "2026-05-15T00:00:00Z",
  "scopes": ["inference:invoke","models:list"]
}
``` Use expires_at for ephemeral access. For SSO we map group -> role.

tom_security: A few security notes from the questionnaire: (a) Hosted API keys stored in our vault are OK for dev, but PHI/regulated data requires Private VPC or on-prem; (b) ephemeral keys should be rotated daily for contractors; (c) we need to sign the DPA addendum before we enable Dedicated with customer data.

jd_customer: Confirming: we only need Dedicated for load tests; devs will use hosted keys. Also want ability to lock down IPs for API access during the POC.

maya_infra: We support IP allowlist on the workspace and we can bind keys to CIDR. For Dedicated in VPC we can set up Security Groups and private endpoints. That will be a short network setup (need CIDR/corp firewall rule from ACME).

ryan_se: Pricing question — sara, can we offer a 30-day trial rate on a 4-GPU pool and bill overage at our normal hourly rate after the trial? Need a simple quote to share.

sara_ae: I'll draft a quote: 30 days @ promotional 40% off committed monthly rate for 4x A100-equivalent GPUs, then standard hourly overage. Also include Hosted token allowance for dev accounts (50k tokens/mo) as part of the POC. Will send pdf by EOD.

tom_security: Also request: ACME's security team needs our SOC2 date + contact and a short runbook for key rotation. I'll attach a checklist in the thread.

maya_infra: Action items: (1) @sara_ae send quote + legal addendum, (2) @ryan_se collect ACME CIDRs and SSO metadata, (3) @tom_security prep SOC2 contact and key-rotation runbook, (4) @maya_infra will create "poc_engineer" role and invite script.

ryan_se: I'll ping ACME for SSO metadata and CIDRs now. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy_bot: deployment scheduled: create-role poc_engineer -> staged to staging workspace at 1781234600.
